concepts.idea: A couple’s day in Chefchaouen: breakfast at the hotel, the medina 8 minutes away, Ras el Ma, the sunset, then back to the Esmeralda, the pool under the stars and the suite.
why: Sells the town and the hotel together
Shows the indoor pool, unique in Chefchaouen

shots.description: Morning: the couple has breakfast in the hotel lounge.
They leave the hotel and walk down to the blue medina. “8 min on foot” badge.
In a blue alley, she takes a photo of him on the steps.
A break by Ras el Ma, the blue houses above.
Sunset over Chefchaouen from the Spanish mosque.
Night: back at the Esmeralda, its façade lit up.
The indoor pool under the starry ceiling, feet in the water.
The suite in the evening, the town lights in the window.
End card: logo, “Pool · Breakfast · Parking”, 8 min from the medina, Book button, WhatsApp, Instagram.

concepts.idea: A family arriving in Chefchaouen: the real questions (where to sleep, where to park, the kids’ breakfast), then the Esmeralda answers them all.
why: Each benefit is ticked in time with the voice

shots.description: The family arrives by car, Chefchaouen appears through the windscreen.
The problem: suitcases to carry up the medina’s stairs.
The problem: nowhere to park.
The problem: and the kids’ breakfast?
At the Esmeralda, the car is parked out front: ✓ Parking.
The kids at the breakfast buffet: ✓ Breakfast.
The triple room, the kids jumping on the beds: ✓ Room for three.
The marble bathroom with bathrobes.
The kids in the indoor pool, the parents by the edge.
The family walking to the medina, 8 minutes away.
End card: logo, benefits, Book button, WhatsApp, Instagram.
